$comment: Shape: globalFacts (object) + map: { canonicalId -> PlatformMapping }. PlatformMapping fields defined in ../schemas/breakdown.schema.json.

globalFacts.availability: All glass APIs are @available(iOS 26.0, *). NO backward-deployment. Gate: if #available(iOS 26, *).
globalFacts.autoAdoption: Recompiling with Xcode 26 makes stock controls (TabView, NavigationStack, .toolbar, .sheet, .popover, .searchable, Slider, Toggle, Stepper, Picker, .alert) adopt Liquid Glass automatically — no code change.
globalFacts.layerRule: Liquid Glass is for the NAVIGATION/FUNCTIONAL layer that floats above content. Do NOT apply .glassEffect() to list rows, scroll content, or full-screen backgrounds.
globalFacts.noStacking: Never place glass directly on glass. Wrap clusters in GlassEffectContainer.
globalFacts.coreModifier: View.glassEffect(_ glass: Glass = .regular, in shape: S = Capsule, isEnabled: Bool = true)
globalFacts.glassVariants: Glass.regular (default adaptive) | Glass.clear (near-transparent, over media) | Glass.identity (off). Chain .tint(Color) and .interactive(). Do NOT emit Glass.filled (not a shipping case).
globalFacts.container: GlassEffectContainer(spacing: CGFloat? = nil, @ViewBuilder content:) — required for 2+ glass elements + morphing.
globalFacts.backdeployFallback: Pre-iOS 26: approximate .glassEffect(.regular) → .background(.ultraThinMaterial); .interactive() → .thinMaterial + manual scaleEffect on gesture.
globalFacts.test: Simulator approximates lensing/specular; TEST ON REAL HARDWARE. Reduce Transparency / Increase Contrast / Reduce Motion handled automatically.
globalFacts.flutterBridge: FLUTTER-ONLY (iOS target). Flutter Cupertino widgets do NOT auto-adopt Liquid Glass (Dart-drawn reimplementations; Flutter team will not build it — issue #170310). Real Liquid Glass is reachable ONLY via a PLATFORM VIEW: UiKitView embedding a UIHostingController whose SwiftUI root applies .glassEffect(_:in:)/.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)/GlassEffectContainer. iOS uses Hybrid Composition so glass refracts real Flutter content. CONSTRAINTS: GlassEffectContainer/glassEffectUnion CANNOT blend glass across separate platform views — group glass primitives inside ONE hosting controller; EagerGestureRecognizer via gestureRecognizers is REQUIRED so native taps aren't stolen by Flutter's gesture arena. PATTERN — Swift: class FCGlassFactory: NSObject,FlutterPlatformViewFactory{ create()->FCGlassView }; FCGlassView{ let host=UIHostingController(rootView: GlassRoot(...).glassEffect(.regular,in:RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:r))); return host.view }; register in AppDelegate. Dart: UiKitView(viewType:'fc-glass-<id>', gestureRecognizers:<EagerGestureRecognizer>). Pure-Dart fallback (lower fidelity): liquid_glass_renderer (Impeller-only, experimental) / liquid_glass_easy (Skia) / BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur)+translucent color. EMIT RULE: if the primitive id is in glassPrimitives AND the design intends glass -> symbol = Flutter UiKitView host embedding map[id].symbol (SwiftUI), bridge=platformView, nativeRef=map[id].symbol. Otherwise -> symbol = the plain Flutter equivalent (Text/Divider/ListView/Image/Switch/Checkbox/Slider/SegmentedButton/AlertDialog/showModalBottomSheet/PopupMenuButton/TabBar/DataTable/PageView/ExpansionTile/CircleAvatar/CircularProgressIndicator...), bridge=pureFlutter, nativeRef=map[id].symbol (or null). NOTE: glassPrimitives are DEFAULT glass candidates (floating functional/navigation layer per Apple HIG) — deliberately NOT all primitives; content (text/list/grid/data) is pureFlutter by design. The AUTHORITATIVE glass signal is the design's motion.glass-blur flag + whether the primitive floats in chrome: glass a listed primitive only if the design intends glass, and glass an UNLISTED primitive if it carries motion.glass-blur.
globalFacts.nativeDecoration: GATE G3 (native-decoration policy): a native control carries ONLY native-vocabulary decoration — an SF Symbol via Image(systemName:) / NativeLiquidGlassIcon.sfSymbol. The action.button contract (params: variant/tint/size/shape + a SYSTEM-symbol icon) has NO brand-glyph slot. A custom brand SVG the design paints inside a button (Google's 4-colour G, a partner logo) is NOT native vocabulary: in native mode DROP it from the render — do NOT rasterise it to PNG to force it in (forcing a non-native graphic into a native control is the bug this gate stops). DROP != discard: the asset manager RECORDS every dropped glyph in the target's NON-bundled provenance/asset_ledger.json (origin, dims, the vector, drop reason); design render mode reproduces it religiously. Applied to EVERY button the SAME way, incl. social-auth — in native mode the Apple button is a native Liquid Glass AdaptiveButton like Google's and BOTH marks (apple.logo, Google G) drop. Do NOT substitute an official provider button (SignInWithAppleButton) as the native default, and do NOT keep one provider's mark but not another's. The ONLY native way a dropped mark could ride a native button is converting it to an SF Symbol — but that path is currently CLOSED for these marks: native_liquid_glass loads icons only via UIImage(systemName:) (system symbols; a custom asset-catalog symbol needs UIImage(named:), not called), the SF Symbols licence forbids logo/trademark glyphs (apple.logo restricted), and Google requires the exact provided G. So SF-Symbol conversion is a future path only for a simple non-trademark tintable glyph. Mirrors the same policy on Android (Material icon vocabulary) and web (lucide).

surface.card.symbol: View.glassEffect(.regular, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: r))  |  or .background(.regularMaterial) for content cards
surface.card.notes: Prefer glass only for FLOATING cards. Content-layer cards → .background(.regularMaterial) (Material, not Glass) per Apple's layer rule. Use .containerConcentric to auto-align corners with container.

surface.glass.notes: Core primitive. .clear over media. Wrap clusters in GlassEffectContainer.

surface.sheet.availability: iOS 16+ detents; iOS 26 auto floating glass
surface.sheet.notes: Partial detents auto-float with inset Liquid Glass; .large → opaque + attached. Morph: matchedTransitionSource + navigationTransition(.zoom).

surface.modal.availability: iOS 26 auto glass for system dialogs

surface.tooltip.notes: No native iOS tooltip. Build via .popover + glass capsule, or long-press preview.

surface.toolbar.notes: Auto-glass. Symbols prioritized over text. .confirmationAction placement auto-applies .glassProminent. Remove old .ultraThinMaterial/.presentationBackground workarounds.

surface.tabbar.api: TabView(selection:) { Tab("Home", systemImage:"house", value:0){...} ; Tab("Search", systemImage:"magnifyingglass", value:1, role:.search){...} }.tabBarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown).tabViewBottomAccessory { ... }
surface.tabbar.notes: Floating glass tab bar. .tabBarMinimizeBehavior(.automatic|.onScrollDown|.never). Tab(role:.search) = floating search button. .tabViewBottomAccessory for persistent glass accessory.

surface.navrail.notes: iPadOS large-screen rail auto-adapts glass. Collapse to TabView on compact width.

surface.sidebar.notes: Sidebar auto-adapts (does not flip in dark mode — intentional).

surface.list.notes: Do NOT glass list rows. Content layer.

action.button.notes: .glassProminent = opaque CTA; .glass = translucent secondary. Destructive → .tint(.red). Known beta artifact: .glassProminent + .circle → use .clipShape(Circle()) workaround.

action.icon-button.notes: Filled → .glassProminent; tonal → .bordered. Badge via .overlay badge view.

action.fab.notes: iOS has NO native FAB. Use a floating .glassProminent circle, or attach via .tabViewBottomAccessory.

action.segmented.notes: Auto-glass. For pill custom style, build GlassEffectContainer + .glass buttons.

action.checkbox.symbol: Toggle(.button) — iOS has no native checkbox
action.checkbox.notes: No native Checkbox on iOS. Use Toggle with .button/.checkbox(macOS) or custom Button + Image(systemName:"checkmark").

action.radio.symbol: Picker — iOS has no native radio
action.radio.notes: No native radio button. Use Picker (segmented/menu) or custom selectable chips in GlassEffectContainer.

action.chip.notes: Custom. Selected → tint or .glassProminent. Removable → trailing x button. Cluster MUST be in GlassEffectContainer.

action.link.availability: iOS 16+ NavigationLink value-based; iOS 26 auto glass

input.text-field.availability: iOS 26 auto glass in chrome; floating → wrap .glassEffect
input.text-field.notes: Auto-glass in chrome. Floating field → wrap in .glassEffect capsule. Secure → SecureField.

input.textarea.notes: Plain; frame height fixed. No glass.

input.search.notes: Auto-glass search field. Use Tab(role:.search) for floating reachability search button.

input.multiselect.notes: No native multiselect control. Use List with selection or chip cluster.

input.toggle-group.notes: No native connected toggle group. Build custom.

feedback.toast.notes: No native toast. Custom overlay + glass capsule + withAnimation(.spring). Or third-party.

feedback.skeleton.notes: No native skeleton. redacted + custom shimmer opacity animation.

feedback.badge.notes: Custom. Count badge → red tint glass; status → neutral.

display.text.notes: Map display→largeTitle, title→title2, subtitle→headline, body→body, caption→footnote, label→caption, overline→caption2.uppercaseSmallCaps.

display.avatar.notes: Glass ring → overlay .glassEffect(Circle()). Initials fallback → Text in Circle.

display.media.notes: Use .backgroundExtensionEffect for content bleeding behind sidebar/card (Podcasts/Maps look).

navigation.tabs.notes: iOS top tabs = segmented Picker. Primary nav uses TabView (bottom).

navigation.dropdown-menu.api: Menu { Button("Edit"){}; Button("Delete", role:.destructive){} } label: { Label("Actions", systemImage:"ellipsis.circle") }
navigation.dropdown-menu.notes: Menu auto-glass popover. Supports sections, destructive roles.

navigation.command.api: Custom: .searchable + filtered List in a sheet
navigation.command.notes: No native command palette. Approximate via searchable + list.

data.table.notes: No native rich table. Grid (iOS 16) or List rows.

data.data-table.api: List(sortedItems){ row in RowView(row) } with sort state
data.data-table.notes: No native data table. Build List + headers + sort.

data.carousel.notes: .page TabView or paged ScrollView with peek.

data.row.api: List { LabeledContent("Distance", value: "5 km") }  // key/value; else HStack { Text(label); Spacer(); Text(value).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
data.row.notes: Single structured row (label/value, key/value, numbered, two-line). LabeledContent for key/value; List row + .listRowSeparator; inset-grouped. Content layer — NOT glassed.

data.chart.api: Chart(data) { BarMark(x: .value("d", $0.d), y: .value("v", $0.v)) }  // LineMark/AreaMark/PointMark; RectangleMark = heatmap; SectorMark (iOS 17+) = pie/donut
data.chart.notes: SwiftUI Charts. Marks: Bar/Line/Area/Point/Rectangle(heatmap)/Sector(iOS17+ pie/donut). Reached via UiKitView; content layer, not glassed.

motion.glass-blur.notes: Apply to surface.* primitives. ContainerConcentric for nested alignment.

motion.morph.notes: Pair .glassEffectID; animate via withAnimation on state. .glassEffectUnion merges shapes.
